# Libraries

```{r}
pacman::p_load(ggplot2,dplyr)
```

# Data

## Power

Create grid

```{r}
mcse=expand.grid(p=seq(0.5,1,0.05),
                 R=c(500,1000,2000,5000)) %>% 
  mutate(mcse=sqrt((p*(1-p))/R),
         margin=1.96*mcse)
```

Plot

```{r}
# mcse
mcse %>% 
  mutate(R=as.factor(R)) %>% 
  ggplot(.,aes(mcse,p,group=R,color=R))+
  geom_line()+
  geom_point()+
  geom_hline(yintercept=0.8,lty=2)+
  theme_bw()
# margin
mcse %>% 
  mutate(R=as.factor(R)) %>% 
  ggplot(.,aes(margin,p,group=R,color=R))+
  geom_line()+
  geom_point()+
  geom_hline(yintercept=0.8,lty=2)+
  theme_bw()
```

## Type I error

```{r}
typei=expand.grid(p=seq(0,0.1,0.01),
                 R=c(500,1000,2000,5000)) %>% 
  mutate(mcse=sqrt((p*(1-p))/R),
         margin=mcse*1.96)
```

Plot

```{r}
# typei
typei %>% 
  mutate(R=as.factor(R)) %>% 
  ggplot(.,aes(mcse,p,group=R,color=R))+
  geom_line()+
  geom_point()+
  geom_hline(yintercept=0.05,lty=2)+
  theme_bw()
# margin
typei %>% 
  mutate(R=as.factor(R)) %>% 
  ggplot(.,aes(margin,p,group=R,color=R))+
  geom_line()+
  geom_point()+
  geom_hline(yintercept=0.05,lty=2)+
  theme_bw()
```
